svg.title: V-16. State-machine records · safety mode, authority, engagement (SysML v2 view stateMachineRecords)
svg.desc: State-machine records view generated from the SysML v2 model. One panel per record of WP-W-05 §5: the panda safety mode (SM-SAFETY-MODE), the Toyota authority controls_allowed (SM-TOY-AUTH) and the selfdrived engagement state (SM-SELFDRIVED), each with its states, initial state and the software units that run it. One row per record transition: trigger, source and target states, status (not implemented, implemented with a gap, reference build only, every build) and the software safety requirements it realises.
svg.text: V-16 · State-machine records · safety mode, authority, engagement
The three records of WP-W-05 §5 as SysML state machines: every record transition with its trigger, its states, its status and the SWSRs it realises
